summary: Executed strict cronograma backend+frontend validation against public URL. Core strict sequencing, stage/floor metadata, guarded writes, remove/fill recovery, viewer readonly/responsive behavior, and state restoration passed. One frontend console error and auth hardening gaps were observed.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout after 5+ failed attempts (6 consecutive invalid password requests still return 200 {ok:false}).
CORS origins are hardcoded (`allow_origins=['*']`) instead of explicit env-driven origins; response headers are inconsistent between OPTIONS and POST for credentialed auth flows.
Admin login does not set app auth in httpOnly cookie; token is returned in JSON and consumed via localStorage Bearer flow.

integration_issues.flow: Admin schedule day detail pending select (after remove/re-add path)
integration_issues.issue: Browser console logs React hydration/DOM nesting error: `<span>` cannot be a child of `<option>`.

action_items: Fix pending-select option rendering path causing `<span>` inside `<option>` console error during cronograma pending flow.
Implement brute-force protections for `/api/admin/verify` (per auth playbook expectation).
Align CORS with explicit origin allowlist from env (not wildcard) for credentialed auth behavior consistency.
If auth hardening is prioritized, migrate admin auth from localStorage-only bearer to httpOnly cookie strategy or document intentional deviation.
critical_code_review_comments: Strict scheduling engine now honors floor-first clockwise sequencing and stage/day invariants correctly with 526 scheduled panels, 7 inferred floors, 24 populated stages, and expected 2027-10-29 finish.
`schedule_source()` correctly excludes unknown facade/location and blocks strict writes via `awaiting_location` guard.
CORS config currently ignores `CORS_ORIGINS` env key and hardcodes wildcard origin; this is a security/config drift risk.
No `seed_admin` routine or lockout controls were found in backend codebase, despite playbook verification checklist.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (strict schedule workflows/readonly/responsive pass; console error observed in pending select path)

context_for_next_testing_agent: After testing, production schedule document `_id=production` was deleted to restore baseline unsaved preview. Current GET /api/schedule: saved=false, revision=0, start=2026-11-01, finish=2027-10-29, working_day_span=311, strategy=strict_floor_clockwise_v1. /api/report/molds summary remains 526 assigned / 533 model / 7 model-unassigned.
rca of the issue: Console issue reproduction: login admin -> open /schedule -> remove one day panel -> pending panel section renders -> browser logs `In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>` with stack pointing to DayDetails pending `<option>` rendering path. This indicates transformed option children are injecting non-text nodes in runtime/hydration path; keep option children text-only in final rendered output.
